verdict.rationale: The docs say an agent can run 'behind a web frontend' or 'on a durable background queue', and that the CLI can 'spin up a uvicorn server to chat with your Pydantic AI agents from your browser'. That amounts to self-hosted serving over HTTP. Nothing shows a managed deployment runtime or a documented API-endpoint deployment path. Missing for 10: a first-party managed runtime or hosting service, documented deploy-to-endpoint workflow, API endpoint contract or auth, independent corroboration.
